title: Nutrition and hydration
summary: Whether people eat and drink enough, the way they like, and whether risks such as weight loss or choking are spotted and acted on.
whenToUse: Every six months, after weight loss or a dehydration-related admission, or when carers prepare meals for many people.

statements.focus: Food and drink records, weight checks and what carers do when someone is not eating or drinking.
Nutrition and swallowing needs in the assessment and care plan, including special diets and textures.
Choking, malnutrition and dehydration risk assessments and how they are kept up to date.
Food likes, culture and religion respected when meals are prepared.
Referrals to the GP, dietitian or speech and language therapist, and following their advice.
